Metabolic pathways involved in the biosynthesis of 5-aminolevulinic acid (5-ALA) and the metabolic engineering strategies applied in this study to enhance its production

Metabolic pathways involved in the biosynthesis of 5-aminolevulinic acid (5-ALA) and the metabolic engineering strategies applied in this study to enhance its production. A green arrow represents an overexpressed gene, a blue arrow represents a weakening gene, and a red arrow represents a deleted gene. EMP pathway, Embden–Meyerhof–Parnas pathway; NOG pathway, non-oxidative glycolysis; C4 pathway, Shemin pathway; C5 pathway, Beale pathway; CIT, citrate; ICT, isocitrate; α-KG, 2-oxoglutarate; SUC-COA, succinyl-CoA; SUC, succinic acid; FUM, fumaric acid; MAL, l-malic acid; OAA, oxalacetic acid; Glu, l-glutamate; GLA-tRNA, l-glutamyl-tRNA; GSA, l-glutamate-1-semialdehyde; 5-ALA, 5-aminolevulinic acid; PBG, porphobilinogen; HMB, hydroxymethylbilane; acnA, aconitate hydratase; icd, socitrate dehydrogenase; gdhA, glutamate dehydrogenase; gltX, glutamyl-tRNA synthetase; hemA, glutamyl tRNA reductase; hemL, glutamate-1-semialdehyde aminotransferase; hemB, porphobilinogen synthase; sucC, succinyl-CoA synthetase beta subunit; sucD, succinyl-CoA synthetase alpha subunit; hemA∗, 5-aminolevulinate synthase; xpk, phosphoketolase; pta, phosphate acetyltransferase; rhtA, threonine and homoserine efflux system; eamA, cysteine and O-acetyl-l-serine efflux system; dppA, dipeptide transporter; grxA, redox coenzyme for ribonucleotide reductase; katE, hydroperoxidase; sodB, superoxide dismutase; PLP, pyridoxal 5′-phosphate; PN, pyridoxine; PNP, pyridoxine phosphate; epd, d-erythrose 4-phosphate dehydrogenase; pdxJ, pyridoxine 5-phosphate synthase; pdxH, pyridoxine 5′-phosphate oxidase; ROS,reactive oxygen species
